title: 列車—軌道耦合振動分析~Coupled vehicle–track vibration analysis
focus: 車軌接觸模態耦合取樣與穩定性~Vehicle-track contact modal coupling sampling and stability
summary: 列車—軌道耦合振動分析以「車軌接觸模態耦合取樣與穩定性」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。車輛與軌道透過輪軌接觸互相交換作用力，車體舒適與輪軌力峰值不是同一輸出，模型必須分清質量層次與接觸條件。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops vehicle-track contact modal coupling sampling and stability through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Vehicle and track exchange forces through wheel contact; carbody comfort and peak contact force are different outputs, and the model must distinguish mass levels and contact conditions. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把列車—軌道耦合振動分析放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。車輛與軌道透過輪軌接觸互相交換作用力，車體舒適與輪軌力峰值不是同一輸出，模型必須分清質量層次與接觸條件。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Coupled vehicle–track vibration analysis in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Vehicle and track exchange forces through wheel contact; carbody comfort and peak contact force are different outputs, and the model must distinguish mass levels and contact conditions. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=1200000 N/m, m=1500 kg；y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=4.50158 Hz。只把 k 增加百分之十，y=4.7213 Hz。模型邊界：單質量線性彈簧；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m1=1500 kg, m2=3000 kg；y=m1*m2/(m1+m2)=1000 kg。只把 m1 增加百分之十，y=1064.52 kg。模型邊界：兩個自由質量間相對運動；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=1200000 N/m, m=1500 kg; y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=4.50158 Hz. Increasing only k with a ten-percent increase gives y=4.7213 Hz. Boundary: Single mass and linear spring; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: m1=1500 kg, m2=3000 kg; y=m1*m2/(m1+m2)=1000 kg. Increasing only m1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=1064.52 kg. Boundary: Relative motion between two free masses; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 單質量固有頻率~Single-mass natural frequency
units.title: 單質量固有頻率~Single-mass natural frequency
units.mechanism: 質量層次選擇決定模態的物理意義。本模型把 k 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 4.7213 Hz。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單質量線性彈簧。使用自由衰減頻率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把車體質量代入輪對模態會錯配尺度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Chosen mass level determines the physical meaning of the mode. In this model, k is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 4.7213 Hz. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Single mass and linear spring. Use free-decay frequency as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Using carbody mass for a wheelset mode mismatches scale; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=1200000 N/m, m=1500 kg；y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=4.50158 Hz。只把 k 增加百分之十，y=4.7213 Hz。模型邊界：單質量線性彈簧；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=1200000 N/m, m=1500 kg; y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=4.50158 Hz. Increasing only k with a ten-percent increase gives y=4.7213 Hz. Boundary: Single mass and linear spring; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以自由衰減頻率區分模型與觀察，先用加速度計與模型質量建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「單質量固有頻率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use free-decay frequency to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using accelerometer and model mass, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Single-mass natural frequency. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 把車體質量代入輪對模態會錯配尺度。這個失效與「單質量固有頻率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查自由衰減頻率，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Using carbody mass for a wheelset mode mismatches scale. This failure and a measurement bias in Single-mass natural frequency can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check free-decay frequency rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把車體質量代入輪對模態會錯配尺度~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using carbody mass for a wheelset mode mismatches scale.
units.practice: 重算「單質量固有頻率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出單質量線性彈簧如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把車體質量代入輪對模態會錯配尺度造成偏離的合成觀察，以自由衰減頻率說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Single-mass natural frequency, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Single mass and linear spring. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Using carbody mass for a wheelset mode mismatches scale. Explain which evidence in free-decay frequency distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 輪軌約化質量~Wheel-track reduced mass
units.title: 輪軌約化質量~Wheel-track reduced mass
units.mechanism: 相對運動的約化質量不同於總質量。本模型把 m1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1064.52 kg。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩個自由質量間相對運動。使用兩質量相對位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；直接使用總質量會低估相對模態頻率，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Reduced mass of relative motion differs from total mass. In this model, m1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1064.52 kg. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Relative motion between two free masses. Use relative displacement of two masses as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Using total mass understates the relative-mode frequency; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m1=1500 kg, m2=3000 kg；y=m1*m2/(m1+m2)=1000 kg。只把 m1 增加百分之十，y=1064.52 kg。模型邊界：兩個自由質量間相對運動；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: m1=1500 kg, m2=3000 kg; y=m1*m2/(m1+m2)=1000 kg. Increasing only m1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=1064.52 kg. Boundary: Relative motion between two free masses; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以兩質量相對位移區分模型與觀察，先用雙位移與已知質量建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「輪軌約化質量」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use relative displacement of two masses to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using paired displacements and known masses, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Wheel-track reduced mass. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 直接使用總質量會低估相對模態頻率。這個失效與「輪軌約化質量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查兩質量相對位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Using total mass understates the relative-mode frequency. This failure and a measurement bias in Wheel-track reduced mass can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check relative displacement of two masses rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：直接使用總質量會低估相對模態頻率~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using total mass understates the relative-mode frequency.
units.practice: 重算「輪軌約化質量」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出兩個自由質量間相對運動如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由直接使用總質量會低估相對模態頻率造成偏離的合成觀察，以兩質量相對位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Wheel-track reduced mass, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Relative motion between two free masses. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Using total mass understates the relative-mode frequency. Explain which evidence in relative displacement of two masses distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 接觸線性化剛度~Linearized contact stiffness
units.title: 接觸線性化剛度~Linearized contact stiffness
units.mechanism: 赫茲力律的切線剛度依接觸壓縮量改變。本模型把 C 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.65e+09 N/m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。赫茲力律在正壓縮附近線性化。使用靜態預載與小擾動力作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；固定接觸剛度無法描述大幅卸載，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Tangent stiffness of the Hertz law depends on compression. In this model, C is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.65e+09 N/m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Hertz law linearized around positive compression. Use static preload and small perturbation force as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Fixed contact stiffness cannot describe large unloading; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：C=100000000000 N/m1.5, delta=0.0001 m；y=1.5*C*sqrt(delta)=1.5e+09 N/m。只把 C 增加百分之十，y=1.65e+09 N/m。模型邊界：赫茲力律在正壓縮附近線性化；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: C=100000000000 N/m1.5, delta=0.0001 m; y=1.5*C*sqrt(delta)=1.5e+09 N/m. Increasing only C with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.65e+09 N/m. Boundary: Hertz law linearized around positive compression; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以靜態預載與小擾動力區分模型與觀察，先用低載接觸試體與位移建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「接觸線性化剛度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use static preload and small perturbation force to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-load contact specimen and displacement, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Linearized contact stiffness. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 固定接觸剛度無法描述大幅卸載。這個失效與「接觸線性化剛度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查靜態預載與小擾動力，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Fixed contact stiffness cannot describe large unloading. This failure and a measurement bias in Linearized contact stiffness can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check static preload and small perturbation force rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：固定接觸剛度無法描述大幅卸載~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Fixed contact stiffness cannot describe large unloading.
units.practice: 重算「接觸線性化剛度」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出赫茲力律在正壓縮附近線性化如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由固定接觸剛度無法描述大幅卸載造成偏離的合成觀察，以靜態預載與小擾動力說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Linearized contact stiffness, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Hertz law linearized around positive compression. units.title: 速度波長激振~Speed-wavelength excitation
units.mechanism: 相同不平順在不同速度激發不同頻率。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 22 Hz。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。等速通過正弦不平順。使用速度掃描與頻譜作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；單一速度測試會漏掉共振區，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~The same irregularity excites different frequencies at different speeds. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 22 Hz. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Constant-speed sinusoidal irregularity passage. Use speed sweep and spectrum as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. One test speed can miss resonance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=60 m/s, lam=3 m；y=v/lam=20 Hz。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=22 Hz。模型邊界：等速通過正弦不平順；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=60 m/s, lam=3 m; y=v/lam=20 Hz. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=22 Hz. units.verify: 本單元以速度掃描與頻譜區分模型與觀察，先用合成幾何輸入與加速度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「速度波長激振」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use speed sweep and spectrum to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. units.anchor: 阻尼對衰減影響~Damping decay scale
units.title: 阻尼對衰減影響~Damping decay scale
units.mechanism: 欠阻尼包絡隨阻尼比與固有頻率衰減。本模型把 zeta 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 0.177661 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。線性欠阻尼自由振動。使用多週期峰值包絡作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；受迫振動不可直接當自由衰減，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Underdamped envelope decays with damping ratio and natural frequency. In this model, zeta is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 0.177661 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Linear underdamped free vibration. Use multi-cycle peak envelope as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Forced response cannot be treated as free decay; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：zeta=0.05 1, fn=5 Hz, t=1 s；y=exp(-zeta*2*pi*fn*t)=0.20788 1。只把 zeta 增加百分之十，y=0.177661 1。模型邊界：線性欠阻尼自由振動；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: zeta=0.05 1, fn=5 Hz, t=1 s; y=exp(-zeta*2*pi*fn*t)=0.20788 1. Increasing only zeta with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.177661 1. Boundary: Linear underdamped free vibration; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以多週期峰值包絡區分模型與觀察，先用停止激振後峰值紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「阻尼對衰減影響」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use multi-cycle peak envelope to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using peaks after excitation stops, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Damping decay scale. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 受迫振動不可直接當自由衰減。這個失效與「阻尼對衰減影響」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查多週期峰值包絡，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Forced response cannot be treated as free decay. This failure and a measurement bias in Damping decay scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check multi-cycle peak envelope rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：受迫振動不可直接當自由衰減~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Forced response cannot be treated as free decay.
units.practice: 重算「阻尼對衰減影響」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出線性欠阻尼自由振動如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由受迫振動不可直接當自由衰減造成偏離的合成觀察，以多週期峰值包絡說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Damping decay scale, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Linear underdamped free vibration. units.mechanism: 每週期點數是精度設定而非普遍穩定保證。本模型把 fmax 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 0.113636 ms。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。指定最高解析頻率。使用時間步收斂結果作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只滿足取樣條件不保證數值積分穩定，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Points per cycle is an accuracy setting, not universal stability assurance. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Specified highest resolved frequency. Use time-step convergence results as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. units.anchor: 接觸卸載比例~Contact unloading fraction
units.title: 接觸卸載比例~Contact unloading fraction
units.mechanism: 卸載比例需保留最小輪重而非只看平均。本模型把 Q0 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.772727 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。正接觸力區間的比值。使用最小與平均接觸力作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；平均正常可能掩蓋短時失去接觸，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Unloading requires minimum wheel load, not only its mean. In this model, Q0 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.772727 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Ratio within positive contact-force range. units.title: 隔振位移傳遞率~Displacement transmissibility
units.mechanism: 基礎激振位移傳遞與頻率比及阻尼有關。本模型把 r 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 0.307513 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單自由度穩態基礎激振。使用基礎與質量位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；位移隔振不等於所有接觸力都降低，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Base-excited displacement transmission depends on frequency ratio and damping. In this model, r is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 0.307513 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Steady single-degree base excitation. Use base and mass displacement as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. units.anchor: 輸出頻譜解析度~Output spectral resolution
units.title: 輸出頻譜解析度~Output spectral resolution
units.mechanism: 記錄長度決定頻率格距，補零不提高實際分辨能力。本模型把 T 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 0.0909091 Hz。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。矩形觀察窗基本格距。使用原始時窗與頻譜格點作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；短紀錄可能把鄰近模態混成一峰，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Record duration sets frequency spacing; zero padding adds no true resolving power. In this model, T is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 0.0909091 Hz. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Basic spacing for a finite observation window. Use original window and spectral bins as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Short records can merge neighboring modes; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：T=10 s；y=1/T=0.1 Hz。只把 T 增加百分之十，y=0.0909091 Hz。模型邊界：矩形觀察窗基本格距；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: T=10 s; y=1/T=0.1 Hz. Increasing only T with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.0909091 Hz. Boundary: Basic spacing for a finite observation window; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以原始時窗與頻譜格點區分模型與觀察，先用保留原始時間紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「輸出頻譜解析度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use original window and spectral bins to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using retained original time record, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Output spectral resolution. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 短紀錄可能把鄰近模態混成一峰。這個失效與「輸出頻譜解析度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查原始時窗與頻譜格點，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Short records can merge neighboring modes. This failure and a measurement bias in Output spectral resolution can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check original window and spectral bins rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：短紀錄可能把鄰近模態混成一峰~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Short records can merge neighboring modes.
units.practice: 重算「輸出頻譜解析度」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出矩形觀察窗基本格距如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由短紀錄可能把鄰近模態混成一峰造成偏離的合成觀察，以原始時窗與頻譜格點說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Output spectral resolution, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Basic spacing for a finite observation window. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Short records can merge neighboring modes. Explain which evidence in original window and spectral bins distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

timeline.event: 運輸研究委員會發布軌道過渡段比較研究摘要。~TRB published its comparative research digest on track transitions.
歐盟公布整合基礎設施互通規範第一二九九號法規。~The EU issued Regulation 1299/2014 for the infrastructure interoperability specification.
美國鐵路管理局發布新版軌道與構造物檢查手冊。~FRA issued its updated Track and Structures Compliance Manual.
